What it does: How many copies the brush places per square unit, at the usual strength. Trees might use 0.02, and grass 2. Used while painting.
The copies' size. 1 is the model's own size. Used while painting.
How much the copies' sizes vary, as a share. 0.2 means up to 20 percent larger or smaller. Used while painting.
The gentlest slope the asset grows on, in degrees. 0 is flat ground. Used while painting.
The steepest slope the asset grows on, in degrees. Trees might stop at 35, while rocks can sit on steeper ground. Used while painting.
How far above the ground each copy stands. A negative number sinks it into the ground, which helps rocks look settled. Used while painting, and again whenever the copies follow the ground.
